pre_caption_prompt: The video is a scenery shot. You do not need to describe the subject motion. Just note that briefly in one to three sentences.
pre_caption:
This is a static scenery shot with a slight zoom-out, showing the exterior of a business.

The video displays the storefront of "Davidson's Furniture," a two-story building on a town street. The ground floor has a dark, shingled facade with large display windows and a green awning. A painted sign on the adjacent white brick wall advertises "Davidson's Furniture Carpet & Window Treatments" and notes the business has been a "Furniture Family Since 1876." A dark SUV is parked on the street to the left.
